Job description

Roles and Responsibilities :

  • Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies to drive business growth, brand awareness, and lead generation.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to launch new products and services, ensuring successful product-market fit and go-to-market plans.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitor analysis to inform marketing decisions.
  • Collaborate with corporate sales teams to develop targeted lead generation campaigns that meet customer needs.

Job Requirements :

  • 12-15 years of experience in IT Services & Consulting industry with expertise in corporate sales management, marketing planning, and strategy development.
  • Proven track record of developing effective marketing campaigns that drive revenue growth and brand visibility.
  • Strong understanding of market research principles and ability to analyze data-driven insights for informed decision-making.
